definition_en: a small secret group plotting against a government or person; as a verb, to conspire secretly
core_image: 烛光下围桌密谋的几张低语的脸
scene: 深夜的书房里，几个身影围着一盏烛灯低声商议。A cabal of ministers plotted to remove the king's favourite.
sceneCN: 这里 cabal 是「阴谋小集团」（第 1 个义项：暗中策划的小圈子）；句意是一伙大臣密谋铲除国王的宠臣。

derivatives.zh: 由 cabala 加 -istic 构成，义为「神秘教的；隐晦难解的」
同源名词，义为「犹太神秘哲学；秘传学说」

senses.title: A secret plotting group
senses.definition: a small group of persons united in secret plotting, especially against a government
senses.definitionCN: 为密谋而结成的小团体，尤指反对政府者
senses.example: A cabal within the army planned the coup.
senses.exampleCN: 军内一个小集团策划了政变。
senses.why: The word first named esoteric lore, then any secret society, then plotters.
senses.whyCN: 这个词先指秘传学问，再指秘密结社，后专指密谋者。

senses.title: The schemes of such a group
senses.definition: the secret plots or intrigues engaged in by such a group
senses.definitionCN: 这类集团从事的秘密策划与阴谋活动
senses.example: Court life was a web of cabal.
senses.exampleCN: 宫廷生活是一张阴谋之网。
senses.why: The group's name is transferred to its activity.
senses.whyCN: 集团的名称转指其活动。

senses.title: To conspire secretly
senses.definition: to form a secret plot or unite in intrigue
senses.definitionCN: 结成秘密同盟进行策划
senses.example: The officers caballed against their commander.
senses.exampleCN: 军官们密谋反对他们的指挥官。
senses.why: The noun of the plotters becomes the verb of plotting.
senses.whyCN: 密谋者的名词转为密谋的动词。

intro.en: Cabal came from Hebrew qabbalah, received lore, through French cabale, moving from mysticism to secret plotting.
intro.cn: cabal 源自希伯来语 qabbalah（秘传之学），经法语 cabale，由神秘学义转指秘密密谋。

items.en: qabbalah meant tradition or received lore, the name of Jewish mysticism.
items.cn: 希伯来语 qabbalah 意为「传承之学」，是犹太神秘哲学之名。

items.en: cabala and cabale carried the mystical sense into Europe.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 cabala 与法语 cabale 把神秘学义传入欧洲。

items.en: cabal widened to any small secret group, then especially plotters.
items.cn: 十七世纪英语 cabal 泛指秘密小团体，后专指密谋集团。

items.en: five ministers called the CABAL (Clifford, Ashley, Buckingham, Arlington, Lauderdale) fixed the political sense.
items.cn: 查理二世五位大臣姓氏首字母恰成 CABAL，使政治义定型。

items.en: cabal now implies sinister secrecy, and the verb cabal is rarer.
items.cn: 如今 cabal 带有阴险密谋的意味，动词义较少使用。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the mystical root; the near-meaning group lists fellow plotting words.
note.cn: 形近组同出神秘学词根；近义组是其他密谋词汇。

entries.definitionCN: 犹太神秘哲学，cabal 的直接来源
缆绳，仅拼写相近，词源无关

entries.definition: a secret plan by a group to do something unlawful
a small dissenting group within a larger one
a military or political group ruling by force

normalIntro.en: Trace the path: received lore, secret brotherhood, dark plot.
normalIntro.cn: 顺着词义轨迹记：秘传之学 → 秘密结社 → 阴谋密党。

normal.cn: 希伯来语 qabbalah 意为「秘传之学」。

normal.en: The CABAL ministers gave the word its political fame.
normal.cn: CABAL 五大臣使这个词染上政治色彩。

normal.en: A cabal is smaller and darker than a faction.
normal.cn: cabal 比 faction 更小更阴。

normal.en: The verb caballed means plotted secretly.
normal.cn: 动词 caballed 指秘密策划。
cabalistic 的文字故意晦涩难解。

abstract.en: See candle shadows lean together over a map.
abstract.cn: 看烛光下的人影凑在一张地图上。

abstract.en: Hear whispers stop the moment the door opens.
abstract.cn: 门一开，耳语声戛然而止。

abstract.en: Feel the cold of a dagger under a cloak.
abstract.cn: 感受斗篷下匕首的寒意。

examples.en: The reform was undone by a cabal of senior officials.
examples.cn: 改革被一伙高官密党推翻了。

examples.en: Historians trace the plot to a small cabal within the palace.
examples.cn: 历史学家追溯这场阴谋到宫内一个小集团。

examples.en: They caballed for months before the uprising.
examples.cn: 起义前他们密谋了好几个月。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「咳·包」——密党开会不敢出声，咳嗽都用袖子「包」住嘴。

root: cabal 源自希伯来语 qabbalah「秘传之学」（犹太神秘哲学之名），经中世纪拉丁语 cabala、法语 cabale 进入英语；因 1667 年前后查理二世五位大臣首字母恰成 CABAL，词义由神秘转向阴谋密党。

sensesIntro.en: From hidden lore to hidden plots: the secret group, its schemes, and the act of plotting.
sensesIntro.cn: 由隐秘之学到隐秘勾当：密党小集团、其阴谋勾当，以及密谋这一行为。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: whispered faces around one candle.
core.cn: 核心意象：一盏烛灯下低语密谋的脸。

intro.en: The word family keeps the sense of hidden knowledge turned to hidden action.
intro.cn: 这个同族词始终保有「隐秘之知转为隐秘之行」的意味。

latinIntro.en: The root is Hebrew, not Latin; it reached English through medieval Latin cabala and French cabale.
latinIntro.cn: 词根是希伯来语而非拉丁语，经中世纪拉丁语 cabala 与法语 cabale 进入英语。
